risks.title: Financial covenant compliance risk
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly mentions financial covenants in the 2021 revolving credit facility and leverage ratios. The Axonics acquisition closed in November 2024 temporarily increased the authorized ratio to 4.75x. Per the 10-K, as of December 31, 2025, the maximum authorized ratio is 4.50x (reduced from 4.75x) and must reach 3.75x for the remainder of the period. The actual ratio of 1.92x as of December 31, 2025 is currently in compliance, but the announced Penumbra acquisition for $14.5 billion funded by $11 billion in debt will increase leverage. Non-compliance with covenants could trigger payment defaults.

risks.title: Risk associated with significant acquisitions
risks.score_rationale: The document details the Axonics acquisition closed in November 2024 (a designated Qualified Acquisition) and the agreement to acquire Penumbra for $14.5 billion (announced January 2026, Exhibit 2.1). These major transactions, funded by additional debt ($11 billion for Penumbra) and equity, significantly increase consolidated leverage and operational integration risks.

risks.title: Intangible asset and goodwill impairment risk
risks.score_rationale: The consolidated balance sheet as of December 31, 2025 shows goodwill of $18.282 billion (41.9% of total assets) and net intangible assets of $7.019 billion (16.1% of total assets), totaling $25.301 billion (58.0% of total assets). These substantial amounts result from past acquisitions (Axonics, Silk Road Medical, Apollo, Relievant, Acotec) and future acquisitions. Fair value estimates used in acquisitions may not materialize, creating goodwill impairment risk.
